blocks.x: EdTech companies sell learning outcomes and must prove them: engagement-to-evidence loops, content ops at scale, assessment integrity and institutional procurement gates. Product velocity matters, but evidence velocity closes renewals. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in learning analytics, content operations, assessment integrity, with institutional compliance close behind. The paths are busy; the decisions are late. Closing that delay is worth more than any single tool purchase.
In EdTech & Learning Platforms, the queues and waits that come up first:

items: Engagement metrics ≠ learning proof; renewals wobble.
SOC 2/ISO evidence manual per audit; deals stall.
GenAI undermines assessment validity; detection blunt.
Cost per learner unknown; margin erodes.
